### Strategy Selector

### Cash-Secured Put — 🟡 MARGINAL (3/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% (76th pctl)
- ❌ Daily RSI ≤40 (RSI 46.9 — neutral, not pulled back)
- ✅ Price near support (0.3% from 200MA)
- ✅ Premium yield ≥1.0% ($310 strike: 1.4%, $315: 1.7%)

**Best strike: $310 (Nov 20, 31 DTE)**
- Premium: ~$4.28 mid (1.4% yield)
- Effective cost basis if assigned: $305.72 (9.5% below current)
- OI: 4,123 — decent liquidity

### Covered Call — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% | ❌ RSI ≥60 (46.9) | ❌ Weekly RSI overbought (46.7) | ✅ Premium yield ≥0.8%

### LEAPS Monitor — 🟡 MONITORING (3/6)

## NVDA ($216.74) — 🏆 TOP PICK

### Strategy Selector
IV Rank ~75% + RSI 36.7 pullback = textbook put-selling setup. High conviction on AI compute thesis. **Recommendation: Sell cash-secured put NOW.**

### Cash-Secured Put — 🟢 GOOD SETUP (4/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% (75th pctl — premium is rich)
- ✅ Daily RSI ≤40 (RSI 36.7 — pulling back into weakness)
- ✅ Price near support ($200 psychological level, $203 = 200MA)
- ✅ Premium yield ≥1.0% ($200 strike: 2.0%, $205: 2.6%)

**Recommended strike: $200 (Nov 20, 31 DTE)**
- Bid/Ask: $3.95/$4.05 — extremely tight
- Premium: ~$4.00 mid → 2.0% yield (24% annualized)
- Effective cost basis if assigned: $196.00 (9.6% below current)
- Open Interest: 56,028 — massive liquidity
- Strike is 7.7% OTM, ~80% probability of profit

**Alternative:** $205 strike ($5.30 mid, 2.6% yield, cost basis $199.70, 5.4% OTM)
**Conservative:** $195 strike ($2.95 mid, 1.5% yield, cost basis $192.05)

### Covered Call — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)
- RSI 36.7 = stock is pulling BACK. Wrong time to sell calls — let it recover first.
- Wait until RSI>60 and price approaches $230-$240.

### LEAPS Monitor — 🔴 NO SETUP (1/6)
- IV Rank 75% = worst time to buy LEAPS. You'd be paying top dollar for time value.
- Only passes: liquid options chain
- Wait for IV collapse to 20th percentile before considering LEAPS.

## TSLA ($373.93)

### Strategy Selector
IV Rank ~46% is moderate. RSI 60.9 leans toward covered calls over puts. Mixed signals. **Recommendation: CC if holding shares; otherwise wait.**

### Cash-Secured Put — 🟡 MARGINAL (2/4)
- ✅ IV Rank ≥40% (46th pctl — barely passes)
- ❌ Daily RSI ≤40 (RSI 60.9 — stock is rallying UP)
- ❌ Price near support (bouncing up, not testing support)
- ✅ Premium yield ≥1.0% ($350: 2.6%, $340: 1.9%)

Wrong timing — selling puts into strength. Wait for pullback.

### Covered Call — 🟡 MARGINAL (3/4)

- OI: 16,103 — very liquid
- If called at $400 w/ $350 basis: $60.53 total profit (17.3%)
- 7% above current price at round-number resistance

**Alternative:** $410 strike ($7.78 mid, 2.1% yield, more room)

### LEAPS Monitor — 🟡 MONITORING (3/6)

- Missing: Daily RSI overbought (wrong direction), IV Rank 46%, pullback only 2.3%
